target_stage: Final judgment on the original eviction petition (RC-01/08).
target_court: Court of Sh. Prashant Kumar, CCJ/ARC, Rohini Courts, Delhi.

IK-50313565:L73:span1.text: Respondent no. 2 is a legal tenant and is in exclusive possession and in full control of the tenanted shop and he is running the business in the said shop himself exclusively.

IK-50313565:L75:span2.text: respondent no. 1 has not illegally subleted the shop to respondent no. 2. Respondent no.1 is running a printing press in the said premises till today in the name and style of S.R. Printer and respondent no. 1 is the sole proprietor of the said shop.

IK-50313565:L79:span3.text: Respondent no. 2 is in exclusive possession and in full control in the tenanted shop and he is running the business in the said shop himself exclusively and opens and closes the shop himself.

IK-50313565:L80:span4.text: at present son of respondent no. 1 is carrying on the business, however, the board of S.R. Printer is still there. During cross examination, petitioner has further stated that tenanted premises is still being used for printing work, till today since the inception of tenancy.

IK-50313565:L82:span5.text: Respondent no. 1 is in full control of his business as well as tenanted premises.

IK-50313565:L83:span6.text: Sanjeev Kumar, his son, opens and closes the shop and sits at the said shop in the capacity of his son. During cross examination, it is further stated by the respondent no. 1, Shyam Singh that Sanjeev Kumar is neither partner nor the CASE No. RC - 01/08 4/10 employee in the said shop.

IK-50313565:L84:span7.text: his son used to help him in his work due to his illness.

IK-50313565:L87:span8.text: He is only assisting his father. It is further stated by him that he is living jointly with his father.
